title: Carbon Monoxide Alarm and Gas Odour Safety Standard — Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
**Carbon monoxide alarm calls.** A call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls with the carbon monoxide alarm symptom is booked only after the caller confirms that everyone has left the home and that the gas utility's emergency line or 911 has been called. This rests on the caller's own statement, given before the booking, by the customer the call is booked for.

**Class and timing.** Such a call is then booked in the earliest class whose window is available. It is never deferred to a later Standard window at the customer's request.

**Test at no charge.** The technician performs the combustion and carbon monoxide test at no charge in every call class, since each class includes that test on heating calls.

**Gas odour.** A caller who reports the smell of gas is told to leave the home and call the gas utility from outside. No call is booked until the utility has made the line safe.

**Billing.** A carbon monoxide alarm caused by a confirmed appliance fault is billed like any other repair.

## Decision table

| Caller reports | Caller has confirmed evacuation and the call to the utility or 911 | Booking |
|---|---|---|
| Carbon monoxide alarm | Yes | Booked in the earliest class with an available window |
| Carbon monoxide alarm | Not yet | Not booked until the caller confirms both |
| Smell of gas | — | Told to leave and call the utility from outside; no call booked until the utility has made the line safe |

## Basis questions

**May a caller with a carbon monoxide alarm ask for next Tuesday's Standard window to avoid an after-hours premium?** No. The call is booked in the earliest class whose window is available and is never deferred to a later Standard window at the customer's request.

**Is the repair of the faulty appliance free?** The carbon monoxide test is at no charge. A repair of a confirmed appliance fault is billed like any other repair.
